findings.title: Feature-disabled and recreate exit codes are never asserted
findings.body: The PR changes the exit-code contract that the docs tell automation to rely on: RECREATE becomes 3 and FEATURE_DISABLED becomes 4. testFeatureNotEnabled only calls assertError on the message and never checks the exit code, so a regression to 0 or 1 would pass. Likewise testWrongVersions (lines 97 and 106) asserts only error text and never checks that the recreate result exits with 3. No test covers the recreate exit code at all, even though the docs present it as the signal for CI/CD pipelines.

findings.title: Feature gate for the 'check' subcommand is untested
findings.body: The new feature gate was added to both UpdateCompatibilityMetadata and UpdateCompatibilityCheck, but testFeatureNotEnabled only launches the 'metadata' subcommand. The 'check' gate, which returns FEATURE_DISABLED before reading the file, has no test. Its early return is the only path that skips validateConfig and file reading for check, so a regression there would go unnoticed.

findings.title: Null-strategy test path runs without rolling-updates, contradicting the docs
findings.body: createInitialDeployment returns early when updateStrategy is null, so the rolling-updates feature is only enabled for non-null strategies. The docs added in advanced-configuration.adoc say the feature 'must be enabled. Otherwise, the Operator will fail.' Either that doc statement is overstated (the operator only fails when update settings are present), or the null-strategy variants of testImageChange and testCacheMaxCount run in a configuration the docs say is invalid. The PR should make the doc precise or enable the feature for the null case too.
